contentEn:
Replacing a gas furnace with a heat pump can cut your home's heating costs by half while adding air conditioning for summers in Metro Vancouver. BC Hydro is currently offering rebates up to $10,000 for qualifying heat pump installations — and Reno Stars handles the entire process from equipment selection through permit and rebate application.

How a Heat Pump Works in BC Winters

A heat pump moves heat instead of creating it, using the same principle as a refrigerator in reverse. Even when outdoor temperatures drop to -10°C, a modern cold-climate heat pump extracts enough warmth from the outside air to heat your home efficiently. The system switches automatically to electric resistance backup for the coldest days, so you never lose comfort.

One unit replaces both your furnace and your air conditioner. For a typical Vancouver home with a 2,000 sq ft living area, a properly sized heat pump system heats and cools the entire space without a separate AC unit. Reno Stars installs heat pumps from Mitsubishi, Daikin and Carrier — brands with proven performance in Lower Mainland climate conditions.

What Does Heat Pump Installation Cost in BC in 2026

Installed costs for a complete heat pump system in BC typically range from $12,000 to $20,000 before rebates, depending on the size of your home and whether you choose a ducted or ductless system. A ducted (central) system for a whole home costs more than a multi-zone ductless setup, but distributes heating and cooling more evenly.

BC Hydro rebates currently cover a significant portion of that cost for qualifying installations. The rebate amount depends on the heat pump's heating efficiency rating — expressed as HSPF (Heating Seasonal Performance Factor) — and whether you are replacing an electric baseboard, gas furnace or oil system. Homeowners who switch from gas or oil typically qualify for the largest incentives because the upgrade produces the greatest reduction in on-grid emissions.

BC Hydro Rebates: How Much Can You Receive

BC Hydro's Next Generation Refrigeration Incentive Program offers rebates from $2,000 up to $10,000 for heat pump installations. To qualify, the heat pump must be listed on BC Hydro's approved product list and be installed by a licensed contractor such as Reno Stars who handles the rebate application on your behalf.

The rebate is paid directly to the contractor and credited against your installation invoice, so you do not need to pay the full amount upfront and wait for reimbursement. Reno Stars includes free rebate application handling as part of every heat pump installation we quote.

Beyond the provincial rebate, the federal Canada Greener Homes Loan offers up to $40,000 in low-interest financing for heat pump upgrades, and the Clean BC Better Homes program may provide additional top-up incentives depending on your area.

Do You Need a Permit for Heat Pump Installation in BC

Yes. In British Columbia, any heat pump installation that involves electrical work requires an electrical permit. If the installation includes new refrigerant lines through walls or floors, a refrigeration permit is also required. Reno Stars obtains all necessary permits as part of our standard installation service — we do not leave permit paperwork to the homeowner.

For most single-family homes in Metro Vancouver, the permit process takes 5 to 10 business days. Our team coordinates the permit application with the local authority having jurisdiction before any work begins, so your project timeline stays on track.

Heat Pump Installation by Reno Stars in the Lower Mainland

Reno Stars has installed heat pumps in homes across Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Surrey and surrounding communities. We handle the full scope: equipment recommendation based on your home's size and insulation profile, permit applications, removal of the old furnace or baseboards, new equipment installation, and BC Hydro rebate submission.

Every installation includes a full walkthrough of the new system and its operating modes. We also install Wi-Fi thermostats compatible with most heat pump brands, allowing you to control temperature from your phone and monitor energy use throughout the year.

Frequently Asked Questions About Heat Pump Installation in BC

Will a heat pump work efficiently in cold Vancouver winters?

Modern cold-climate heat pumps maintain heating output at temperatures as low as -15°C to -20°C. A properly sized unit will heat your Metro Vancouver home through every winter without dropping below your thermostat setpoint. The Mitsubishi Zubadan and Daikin Altazur lines are specifically rated for Canadian cold-climate performance.

How long does a heat pump installation take?

A complete heat pump installation for a single-family home typically takes 2 to 3 days — one day to remove the old system and install the new unit, and a second day for electrical connections, thermostat wiring and system commissioning. Permits typically take 5 to 10 business days to be issued before work can begin.

Does a heat pump increase your home's value?

Yes. A heat pump installation typically recovers 80% to 100% of its cost in increased home value, according to remodeling industry cost-vs-value reports for the Vancouver area. The energy efficiency improvements are attractive to buyers who understand the operating cost savings compared to gas or oil heating.

Can I get a heat pump if my home does not have ductwork?

Absolutely. A multi-zone ductless (mini-split) heat pump system delivers heating and cooling to individual rooms through wall-mounted units connected to an outdoor compressor. This is often the best option for older Vancouver homes without central ducting, townhouses and apartments. Reno Stars installs both ducted and ductless systems.

Planning a heat pump installation in Metro Vancouver? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. We serve Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Coquitlam, Coquitlam and all Lower Mainland communities.

热泵如何在BC冬季运作

热泵不是产生热量，而是转移热量，原理与冰箱相反。即使室外温度降至-10°C，现代低温气候热泵仍能从室外空气中提取足够的热量为您的房屋供暖。系统会在最寒冷的日子自动切换至电阳极备用电阻供暖，确保您永远不会失去舒适感。

一台设备同时取代您的炉子和空调。对于典型2,000平方英尺的温哥华住宅，适当规格的热泵系统可为整个房屋供暖和制冷，无需单独的空调设备。Reno Stars安装三菱、大金和开利品牌热泵——这些品牌在弗雷泽河下游气候条件下性能已获验证。

2026年BC热泵安装费用是多少

在补贴前，BC省全套热泵系统的安装费用通常在$12,000至$20,000之间，具体取决于您房屋的面积以及您选择管道系统还是无管道系统。管道（中央）系统全屋供暖的费用高于无管道多区域设置，但供暖和制冷分布更均匀。

BC水电局的补贴可抵消该成本的很大一部分。补贴金额取决于热泵的供暖能效等级（以HSPF即供暖季节性能系数表示）以及您是否在更换电底板、燃气炉或燃油系统。从燃气或燃油更换的用户通常有资格获得最大激励，因为升级可产生最大的电网减排效益。

BC水电局补贴：您能获得多少

BC水电局的下一代制冷激励计划为热泵安装提供$2,000至$10,000的补贴。要符合资格，热泵必须在BC水电局批准产品清单上，并且由Reno Stars等持牌承包商安装，我们代表您处理补贴申请。

补贴直接支付给承包商，并从您的安装发票中抵扣，因此您无需先支付全款再等待报销。Reno Stars在每项热泵安装报价中均包含免费补贴申请处理服务。

除省级补贴外，联邦加拿大绿色住房贷款为热泵升级提供高达$40,000的低息融资，而Clean BC Better Homes计划可根据您所在地区提供额外补充激励。

需要。在不列颠哥伦比亚省，任何涉及电气工作的热泵安装都需要电气许可。如果安装包括通过墙壁或地板的新制冷剂管路，则还需要制冷许可。Reno Stars作为标准安装服务的一部分获取所有必要许可——我们不会将许可文书工作留给业主。

对于弗雷泽河下游大多数单户住宅，许可流程需要5至10个工作日。我们的团队在工作开始前与当地主管部门协调许可申请，确保您的项目时间表保持正常。

Reno Stars在弗雷泽河下游的热泵安装服务

Reno Stars已在温哥华、列治文、本拿比、科奎尔特兰、萨里及周边社区的住宅中安装了热泵。我们处理全部工作范围：基于您房屋的面积和隔热概况进行设备推荐、许可申请、旧炉子或底板拆除、新设备安装以及BC水电局补贴提交。

关于BC热泵安装的常见问题

热泵能在寒冷的温哥华冬季高效运作吗？

现代低温气候热泵在低至-15°C至-20°C的温度下仍能保持供暖输出。适当规格的设备将为您的弗雷泽河下游住宅在每个冬季供暖，不会低于您的恒温器设定值。三菱Zubadan和大金Altazur系列专门为加拿大低温气候性能而设计。

热泵安装需要多长时间？

单户住宅的完整热泵安装通常需要2至3天——第一天拆除旧系统并安装新设备，第二天进行电气连接、恒温器接线和系统调试。许可通常在工作开始前需要5至10个工作日发放。

热泵会增加房屋价值吗？

是的。根据温哥华地区的装修行业成本价值报告，热泵安装通常可回收成本的80%至100%。能源效率提升对了解燃气或燃油供暖运营成本节省的买家很有吸引力。

如果我的房屋没有管道系统，我可以安装热泵吗？

当然可以。多区域无管道（分体式）热泵系统通过连接到室外压缩机的墙壁安装设备向各个房间提供供暖和制冷。这通常是没有中央管道的温哥华老房子、联排别墅和公寓的最佳选择。Reno Stars同时安装管道和无管道系统。
